name: ALL COUNTY SHEET METAL INC
old_description: All County Sheet Metal has been serving customers in South Florida since 1982.  Our shop is located close to I-95 at Exit 64, 10th Avenue North in Lake Worth. We are a Lake Worth sheet metal company, but we service customers all over South Florida.
about:
All County Sheet Metal was founded in 1982 in Lake Worth Beach, Florida, and has operated from a shop near I-95 at Exit 64 on 10th Avenue North. The company serves customers throughout South Florida, including West Palm Beach, Delray Beach, Boca Raton, and Fort Lauderdale.

The shop produces both standard and custom sheet metal products, with a focus on HVAC components such as auxiliary drain pans, ductwork, and roofing fixtures, as well as curbs and doghouse covers. Processes include MIG (GMAW) welding, spot welding, hot iron and torch soldering, and plasma cutting on a Vulcan system with supporting software. Manual layout and design assistance from a network of professional mechanical and structural engineers are also available. Jobs range in value from $45 to over $10,000, and the company maintains a production line for stock items that are available for immediate pickup.

Primary customers are HVAC contractors, but the company also supports plumbers, roofers, property managers, electricians, and individual homeowners. Its accounts span from individual buyers to Fortune 500 companies, and the shop emphasizes that no job is too small.

All County Sheet Metal states its goal is to deliver quality products and service in a timely manner. The presence of a full-time welder, bilingual office staff, and membership in the Palm Beach Air Conditioning Contractors Association (PBACCA) are cited as factors that help meet that goal.
